title: Employ staff under the Aquaculture Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Aquaculture Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Aquaculture Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia engaged in the aquaculture industry and their employees in the classifications in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Aquaculture Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award, the aquaculture industry means the breeding, production, farming and related harvesting of fish, shellfish, crustacea and marine vegetation and ancillary operations including initial preparation for market.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Aquaculture Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
